scope: Independent provenance/domain, q0/ug0, entropy, ETOT/TS, and repeat audit of the four assembled W1 lambda-zero captures. No nonzero-lambda response or W2 values are included.

source_convention_and_domain.writer_mapping: source/self.f90 basis loop m_loop=0..2*ell passes row=base+ell^2+m_loop and col=m_loop-ell; CSV writer serializes col unchanged. Raw col is therefore physical m in [-ell,+ell]. Site-major/spin-major row is site*18+spin*9+ell^2+(m+ell), spin is zero-based, and bands are zero-based global spin-inclusive rows.

capture_domain.k_indices: 0..1727 inclusive, derived from each hash-bound unreduced PRE mesh
capture_domain.logger_selection: The selected total-energy diagnostic is the last HUBBARD_MOMENT_ENERGY_TOTAL line before the unique Converged marker; its count matches the final CSV iteration. stdout.log is the captured g_logger stream.

source_convention_and_domain.runtime_checks: Each stdout contains one Converged marker and one literal R05 NOT APPLICABLE message; all CSV/stdout/run-manifest hashes, execution source/binary, PRE input, seed, and static assets match the frozen capture inventory.

calibration.operator: W1=I_5 on the onsite spherical d block; g0=Tr(W1 P_standard).

energy_formula.local: F=ETOT_local+lambda*Tr(W1*P)-TS; lambda=0 at this calibration, so external term is exactly zero.
energy_formula.provenance: ETOT and TS are preserved tokens from the selected final HUBBARD_MOMENT_ENERGY_TOTAL stdout line; no additional candidate_b term is added.

calibration.cross_mode_check: At lambda=0, local and spectral P, ETOT, TS, and F anchors agree in the assembled data. Entropy is evaluated over the full global spin-inclusive band domain with captured k weights and no extra spin multiplier.

independent_checks.P_reconstruction_uncertainty: The reviewed assembler propagates ES token half-quantum plus exact Decimal-to-binary parse displacement, outward complex component radii, telescoping disk error for w*f*psi_a*conjg(psi_b), operation-count gamma bounds for products/sums/site/spin accumulation, and componentwise W*P trace bounds. A phase-only synthetic perturbation test passes.
independent_checks.entropy: Uses the same source occupation kernel with hash-bound occupation, k-weight, temperature, eigenvalue, Fermi-level, and final-state tokens. Independent high-precision entropy center and interval/error bounds are carried in B_TS.
independent_checks.h2_rule: The separately approved h2-dominance synthetic suite passes; this lambda-zero calibration does not inspect response derivatives or classify the W1 identity result.
